sources.browser_read: Successful web open/find; direct-byte fetch failed, no content SHA claimed.

takeaways: Use item identities and thread/turn bindings for observed tool events; usage notifications are not provider invoice identities.
Cache reads/writes need actual usage counters; stable local references or fewer bytes do not prove cache hit or bill saving.
SQLite documents seek-after-last-key pagination rather than repeated first-page/offset scans; existing immutable seq supports a scalar seek.
scope: Official mechanism context, not this repository performance or provider savings.
